summary: A monthly untutored figure-drawing session with a live nude model, run as a paid, individually bookable session at Trackside Studios, a commercial art gallery/studio in the River Arts District. There is no membership language, roster, or affiliated Facebook/Meetup group tied specifically to the session, and the studio's own site presents it as a 'Book Now' class alongside its other paid classes rather than a standing community.

evidence.note: Listings describe a fixed untutored format (warmup poses then a long pose) with pre-registration requested and a $20 price, but no mention of members, regulars, or a group name.

Trackside Studios' own classes page lists the 2-hour ($12) and 3-hour ($17) Life Drawing sessions with per-session start dates and individual 'Book Now' buttons, styled the same as its other paid classes, with no membership or community framing.

General web searches for the session and for Asheville-area untutored life-drawing sessions turned up several comparable business-run open-studio offerings (Red House Gallery, Studio Ten) but no evidence of a named, self-identifying community tied to Trackside's session specifically.
Trackside Studios is a commercial gallery/studio space run by managers hosting ~60 resident artists; the life drawing session is one of its recurring paid offerings, not a group organized around it.
